  (S₁ : Type v) →

items.informal_description: Let $R$ be a commutative semiring and let $S_1, S_2$ be types indexing variables. This defines the canonical ring homomorphism from the iterated multivariate polynomial ring $(R[S_2])[S_1]$ to the multivariate polynomial ring $R[S_1 \oplus S_2]$. The homomorphism maps a variable from the outer ring (indexed by $S_1$) to the corresponding variable in the left part of the disjoint union $S_1 \oplus S_2$, and a variable from the inner ring (indexed by $S_2$) to the corresponding variable in the right part.

items.informal_name: Power sum symmetric polynomial of degree $ n $
items.type: (σ : Type u_5) → (R : Type u_6) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → [Fintype σ] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R
items.informal_description: For each natural number $ n $, the polynomial $ \sum_{i} X_i^n $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, where the sum is taken over all variables $ X_i $ indexed by the finite type $ \sigma $.

items.informal_name: Diagonal Matrix of Indeterminate X Maps to X under Matrix-Polynomial Equivalence
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : Type w} [inst_1 : DecidableEq n] [inst_2 : Fintype n],
  matPolyEquiv (Matrix.diagonal fun x => Polynomial.X) = Polynomial.X
items.informal_description: The canonical $ R $-algebra isomorphism between $ n 	imes n $ matrices over the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ and polynomials over $ n 	imes n $ matrices with coefficients in $ R $ sends the diagonal matrix with $ X $ on its diagonal to the indeterminate $ X $ itself, i.e., $ \text{matPolyEquiv}(\text{diag}(X,\ldots,X)) = X $. This identifies scalar matrices with constant polynomial coefficients under the isomorphism.

items.informal_name: Elementary symmetric polynomial substitution for monomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} {n m : ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] {r : R},
  r ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (t : Fin n →₀ ℕ),
      n ≤ m →
        ⇑(ofLex (AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree (⇑toLex) (MvPolynomial.esymmAlgHomMonomial (Fin m) t r))) =
          (Fin.accumulate n m) ⇑t
items.informal_description: The function maps a monomial in $ n $ variables, represented by a finite support function $ t $ and coefficient $ r $, to the symmetric polynomial obtained by substituting each variable $ X_i $ with the $(i+1)$-th elementary symmetric polynomial in variables $ \sigma $. This constructs an element of the symmetric polynomial subalgebra by evaluating the monomial at elementary symmetric polynomials.

items.informal_name: Power Sum Symmetric Polynomial of Degree 1
items.type:
∀ (σ : Type u_5) (R : Type u_6) [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Fintype σ],
  MvPolynomial.psum σ R 1 = ∑ i, MvPolynomial.X i
items.informal_description: The power sum symmetric polynomial of degree 1 in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ is equal to the sum of all variables $ X_i $, i.e., $ \sum_{i \in \sigma} X_i $.
